- As a child, he played Short Round in Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984).
- He later played Waymond Wang in Everything Everywhere All at Once (2022).
- The film follows a family that travels across different universes.
- He won an Academy Award for the role.
- Chinua Achebe was a Nigerian novelist.
- He wrote Things Fall Apart (1958).
- The novel tells the story of Okonkwo, a leader in an Igbo village.
- It shows how British colonization changed village life.
- Achebe also wrote poetry and essays.
- Yo-Yo Ma is an American cellist.
- He founded the Silkroad Ensemble in 1998.
- The ensemble brings together musicians from more than 20 countries.
- It performs music inspired by cultures along the ancient Silk Road.
- Ma has won 19 Grammy Awards.
- Hayao Miyazaki is a Japanese animator and director.
- He co-founded Studio Ghibli in 1985.
- He directed Spirited Away (2001).
- The film tells of a girl who must work in a spirit world bathhouse to save her parents.
- It won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
Marie Byrd Land is an unclaimed region of Antarctica.
Construction of Byrd Station in Marie Byrd Land was begun in 1956 by the US.
Byrd Station was abandoned in 1972.
John Carpenter used Byrd Station as a model for an Antarctic station in crisis for his movie The Thing.
James Rollins used Byrd Station as a model for an Antarctic station in crisis for his novel The 6th Extinction.
- Neuschwanstein Castle is in Bavaria, Germany.
- It was built in the 1800s for King Ludwig II.
- Walt Disney used it as a model for Sleeping Beauty Castle at Disneyland.
- The animated film Frozen also drew on castles in this style.
- The video game Castle Quest used Neuschwanstein as a model for its royal palace.
- Monroeville is a small town in Alabama.
- Harper Lee grew up there.
- To Kill a Mockingbird is set in Maycomb, a fictional town based on Monroeville.
- Truman Capote also grew up in Monroeville.
- Capote's novel Other Voices, Other Rooms includes a town based on Monroeville.
- Skellig Michael is a rocky island off the coast of Ireland.
- Monks built stone huts there more than 1,000 years ago.
- Star Wars: The Force Awakens filmed scenes on the island.
- Star Wars: The Last Jedi also filmed scenes there.
- The island is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
- The Titanic was a British passenger ship that sank in 1912.
- More than 1,500 people died.
- James Cameron's film Titanic (1997) recreated the ship in detail.
- Clive Cussler's novel Raise the Titanic!
(1976) imagines the ship being lifted from the ocean floor.
- The wreck was found in 1985.
- Christ Church is a college of Oxford University.
- Its dining hall was built in the 1500s.
- The Harry Potter films used the hall as a model for Hogwarts' Great Hall.
- The video game Spellbound Academy also used the hall as a model for its school dining room.
- Christ Church has more than 600 students.
